subject: Aligning demo time for US-East customer and EU engineering (DST week)
content:
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Demo request: demo for Clinical Ops team (East Coast)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the quick responses — our Clinical Ops leadership would like a 45-minute demo focused on inference latency and cost controls next week.

Preferred window: Tue/Wed/Thu between 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM ET. We understand Redwood's EU engineering team is often on CET; if that conflicts, happy to take a recording or shift earlier/later.

Two attendees for now: Casey Morgan (ops) and myself. Can you confirm availability and proposed agenda?

Best,
Alex

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo request: demo for Clinical Ops team (East Coast)

Hi Alex — thanks, we can absolutely run that. Quick note: the week you requested overlaps Europe’s DST transition (EU moves clocks forward a week later than the US), so the usual hour offsets shift for a small window. I wanted to propose concrete slots that avoid the one-week awkwardness.

Proposed options (all ET):
- Option A: Tue Apr 6, 2:00 PM ET / Wed Apr 7, 8:00 PM CEST (late for EMEA) — Jonas can join remotely but prefers not to push past 8:00 PM.
- Option B: Wed Apr 7, 11:00 AM ET / Wed Apr 7, 17:00 CEST — early for you; later for EU but within business hours.
- Option C: Thu Apr 8, 8:00 AM ET / Thu Apr 8, 14:00 CEST — early for you but avoids evening hours for EU.

If none work, we can do Option D: record with a short 20-minute live Q&A at a compromise time. Attached is a draft agenda — Ben, Jonas: can you confirm which of these Jonas is comfortable joining live for?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com | M: +1 415-555-0119

Attachment: demo-agenda-v1.pdf (46 KB)

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:08:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: demo for Clinical Ops team (East Coast)

Evelyn — quick note from the engineering side. Jonas can do Option B (Wed Apr 7, 11:00 ET / 17:00 CEST) but prefers that we avoid any times after 18:00 CEST. Also, because of the one-week DST stagger, please confirm which timezone labels are in the calendar invite (ET vs. EDT) so the invite doesn't auto-shift.

I’ll attach a small timezone matrix I use for sales + SE scheduling — saves a lot of back-and-forth.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: timezone-matrix.xlsx (12 KB)

---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:37:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: demo for Clinical Ops team (East Coast)

I can join live on Wed Apr 7 at 17:00 CEST. One operational caveat: EU shifts clocks forward at 01:00 on Sun Apr 3, while US switches earlier on Sun Mar 14; during the week there is a 1-hr drift compared to our usual offsets.

Please pick Option B and set the calendar event times explicitly as "Wed, Apr 7, 11:00 AM EDT / 5:00 PM CEST (explicit)" and include the timezone tag in the invite description. That prevents the calendar from showing the wrong local time for participants.

Also recommend recording and disabling auto-update for recurring invites for this specific event.

Cheers,
Jonas
EMEA Sales Engineer

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@cardinalhealth.com>, Casey Morgan <casey.morgan@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Confirmed: Demo Wed Apr 7, 11:00 AM ET / 17:00 CEST (45 min) — agenda attached

Hi Alex/Casey — thanks for the flexibility. Confirming Wed Apr 7, 11:00 AM ET / 5:00 PM CEST for a 45-minute session: 25-minute product walkthrough (latency + batching strategies), 10-minute infrastructure Q&A, 10-minute next-steps and pricing.

I've attached the updated agenda and the timezone matrix Ben referenced. Calendar invite will follow with explicit timezone labels; recording enabled and we’ll keep it to 45 minutes.

Action items:
- Alex/Casey: accept calendar invite when received (I’ll send in the next hour).
- Jonas: join from EMEA and lead the infrastructure Q&A.
- Ben: bring the cost/throughput examples referenced on slide 3.

Thanks,
Evelyn

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (52 KB), timezone-matrix.xlsx (12 KB)

---
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Casey Morgan <casey.morgan@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Confirmed: Demo Wed Apr 7, 11:00 AM ET / 17:00 CEST (45 min) — agenda attached

Hi all — accepted the invite. Small ask: could we nudge the demo 30 minutes earlier to 10:30 AM ET? One of our stakeholders has a conflicting meeting that popped up. If 10:30 ET (16:30 CEST) works for Jonas and Ben, that would be ideal.

If you need to keep it at 11:00 AM ET, no problem — the recording will suffice for the stakeholder who misses the start.

Thanks,
Alex

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@cardinalhealth.com>, Casey Morgan <casey.morgan@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 19:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Confirmed: Demo Wed Apr 7, 11:00 AM ET / 17:00 CEST (45 min) — agenda attached

Alex — thanks for the heads-up. Jonas confirmed via IM that 16:30 CEST / 10:30 AM ET works fine. I updated the calendar invite (explicit labels: "Wed, Apr 7, 10:30 AM EDT / 4:30 PM CEST") and attached the final agenda (v2) and timezone matrix for your reference. Recording is enabled; we’ll start promptly at 10:30 ET.

Final details:
- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cardinal-demo-20270406
- Duration: 45 min (10:30 AM ET / 16:30 CEST)
- Recording: on; will be shared within 24 hours.

See you Wednesday — please let me know if anything else changes.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com | D: +1 415-555-0119
